supplemental_searches.notes: Primary texts, archival reports, and official project pages were opened for included records. Repository families R1-R5 were applied through official-project discovery and source inspection already recorded by Phase C.
One pass from Shu surveys, Zhang et al. 2011, Wang et al. 2008, Luo et al. 2013, and Balsara et al. 2025 added no comparison that changed F0-F5 or the constitution.

coverage_limitations: Scopus and Web of Science were unavailable.
Crossref was screened only through the first 50 relevance-ranked records per family and produced very broad totals.
OpenAlex was screened only through the first 100 relevance-ranked records per family, except S7 and S9 where fewer existed.
The review cannot prove that no controlled GPU or differentiable FD/FV comparison exists; it records that none was established by the frozen searches.
Non-English and poorly indexed literature may be underrepresented.
Search results and official repositories are time-varying snapshots as of the review date.
